description: Header file defining the Err class used for error handling in the GN build system, including error details, sub-errors, and printing methods.

classes.name: Err
classes.description: Represents an error with location, message, help text, sub-errors, and methods for printing.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Constructors for creating error instances at various locations (point, range, token, node, value).

methods.name: has_error
methods.description: Checks if the Err instance represents an actual error.

methods.name: PrintToStdout
methods.description: Prints the error details to standard output.

methods.name: PrintNonfatalToStdout
methods.description: Prints the error as a warning (nonfatal) to standard output.
